text: Coffee with Grace after the team meeting. She's 20 weeks pregnant and finally told her manager Rory, who was apparently lovely about it, though his boss is less thrilled about the timing with the restructure. Her next scan is on 2 November 2026 and she's a bit nervous because last time they had to recheck the heart. Her husband can't get the morning off so her sister is going with her. Text her that evening to see how it went.
Long call with Reza. His sister Noor had a baby girl on Saturday, 3.2kg, called Leila. He's flying out to see them the week after next. Mum's already there.

Lunch w Yaw and Michael. Michael's leaving the firm end of November, going to a competitor. Yaw is taking over his clients and is clearly stressed about it. Leaving drinks are the Thursday before he goes.
Kerry's christening for little Finn is 14 March 2027 at St Mary's. She asked if I'd be godparent!! Need to say yes properly, maybe a card. Lunch at her parents' afterwards.
Rosa says her boss Mia is going on maternity leave in January and nobody knows who's covering. Rosa might apply to act up. She's nervous about the conversation with HR.
Caught up with Joe in the car park. His wife Efua is due in February. They've painted the nursery yellow. He's doing paternity leave for four weeks and then going part time.
Deepa's baby shower is off, her mum's not well enough to travel. She'll do something small after the birth instead. Check in with her next week about her mum.
Note to self: buy something for Louis and Rebecca's new baby before Sunday. They mentioned they're short on muslins and those sleepsuits with zips.

Fatima mentioned the client from Olsen & Co is being a nightmare again, third escalation this month. Lars from accounts keeps getting dragged into calls at 7pm and he's had enough. She thinks Lars is about to quit. Apparently his partner got a job in Bergen so they might move next spring anyway. Fatima's worried she'll end up with his workload on top of hers. Should take her for lunch next week and see how she's holding up.

Oisín and Zara are expecting! Due date is 9 May 2027. Zara's had awful morning sickness, can barely get through a workday and has been sneaking out of meetings. Her boss Kerry has been really good about letting her work from home. Oisín is over the moon, he told the whole five a side group before she'd even told her parents, which did not go down well. Send them something nice, maybe a meal delivery voucher for her.
Jada's presentation to the board is Tuesday. She's practising every night and says she can't sleep. Text her good luck the night before and ask how it went the day after.
Had a catch up with Cem. His dog Biscuit had surgery on his leg on Friday, recovering ok but needs to wear the cone for two weeks. Cem is working from home so he can keep an eye on him.
Idris got promoted to team lead!! Starts in the new role on 1 December 2026. His wife Tanvi is throwing a small dinner for him the Saturday before. I'm bringing dessert.
Oscar is still struggling after his dad's funeral. He's back at work but very quiet. His brother Bao is staying with him for a bit. Must remember to ask him for a pint, no pressure.
Simone's twins were christened yesterday. Gorgeous day. Her mother-in-law cried through the whole thing. Simone said she's exhausted but happy.
Zoe from the Hughes account rang. Contract renewal meeting is 18 November 2026. Her manager Haruto wants the figures the day before. Haruto's on paternity leave until then though so she's covering.
Kasia told me her sister Laura is pregnant with her third. Laura's due in April. Kasia's the go-to babysitter for the other two already and slightly dreading it lol.
Keisha's mum had a fall last week, broke her wrist. Keisha's been doing the hospital runs before work. Should drop her a message tomorrow to see how her mum's getting on.
Rory mentioned in 1:1 that the restructure announcement is 3 November. He's worried about Grace's team. Can't say anything yet.
Grace (Gracie to everyone at work) had her baby boy this morning!! Named him Theo. Both doing well. Group card is going round, need to sign it and chip in for the hamper before Friday.

Dinner w Reza and Noor. Noor's going back to work in March 2027 after mat leave, three days a week, same team but a new manager she hasn't met. Reza is taking Fridays off to cover nursery pickups and his mum does Wednesdays. Their little one starts nursery settling in sessions the week before she goes back. Noor's anxious about leaving her, Reza seemed more relaxed. Offered to have Leila one Saturday so they can get a night out.
Note for later: Yaw loves Arsenal, Michael is into cycling.
Booked the car service for Thursday morning. Still need to sort the gas bill.
Kerry said her brother Sam and his wife Rosa just found out they're having a boy. Gender reveal party is the Saturday after next. Kerry hates gender reveals but is going for Sam.
Mia's last day before mat leave was Friday. Cake, a cot mobile from the team, a few tears. Her due date is 12 January 2027. She wants to be told if anything big happens with the Popescu project.

Joe's dad turns 70 on 5 December. Joe's organising a surprise do the weekend after at the cricket club, about forty people, and his sister Efua is handling the food. Their dad has no idea. He's into fly fishing and whisky, Joe says a nice hip flask would go down well if I want to chip in. Need to tell Joe by Friday if I'm in.

Efua is finding the last trimester hard, back pain and not sleeping. She's off on leave from next week. Joe says she'd love visitors but not until after the baby's here. Maybe send her a care package that week.
Call with Deepa. Her mum's out of hospital and doing better. The baby's due any day now. Deepa wants me to be on standby to feed the cat (Mango) when she goes into labour.

Louis said Rebecca's struggling a bit with the newborn stage. Baby's not feeding well and she's barely sleeping. He goes back to work Monday and he's worried. Remind me to message Rebecca on Monday, just to check in.
Lars handed in his notice today. Last day 30 November. Fatima's gutted, he was her best colleague. They're moving to Norway in January 2027.
Haruto and his partner Kasia had their baby! A girl, born 2 days early. Haruto sent photos in the team chat. Organise a collection for them, maybe flowers and a voucher.
Zara's 12 week scan went well yesterday, everything looks normal. She's announcing at work on Monday. Ask her how the announcement went afterwards.
Quick chat with Oisín. He's taking his mum to her hospital appointment on 4 November 2026, so he'll be out that morning. Need to cover his standup.
Jada smashed the board presentation, they approved the budget. Her boss Michael was over the moon. Send her a congrats message.
Cem's niece Bao is getting baptised in Istanbul in the spring, March 2027 he thinks. Whole family is flying out. He's nervous about the long flight with his elderly dad.
Idris told me Tanvi is pregnant! Very early days, only 8 weeks. Due around June 2027. They're both terrified and thrilled. He's coeliac so I'll do a GF cake at some point to celebrate.
Oscar's back on form. He and his partner Simone are going to Lisbon for a week from 10 December. First holiday since his dad passed.
Zoe Gonzalez from the client side is leaving to have a baby. Her replacement is someone called Keisha Thomas, starting 1 December. Need to set up an intro call with Keisha the week after she starts.

Talked to Kasia about Laura. Her baby came early, last Tuesday, at 33 weeks, and is in the special care unit for at least another fortnight. Laura's ok but shattered, she's expressing every three hours and her husband had to go back to work after a week. Kasia's driving down there the day after tomorrow and staying the weekend. I should send something for Laura and the baby, maybe ask Kasia what's actually useful in SCBU.
Keisha says her nan turns 90 on 2 November 2026. Big family lunch the day before at her aunt's. Keisha's making the cake, nervous about it.

Team meeting notes. Rory's off from next Wednesday for knee surgery, back in two weeks if physio goes ok. Grace is covering while he's out, which is a lot given she's 30 weeks. Mia's maternity cover starts 6 January and it's Rebecca from the Leeds office. Client visit to Popescu moved to 20 November 2026. Haruto wants the deck ready the day before. Ask Grace if she needs me to take the Thursday calls.
Bumped into Noor at the shops with the baby. Leila's 3 months now and smiling. Noor said she's not sleeping but loving it. Her husband Lars is great apparently.
Yaw's wife had their second, a boy called Kwame, on Sunday night. Yaw's off for two weeks. I'll handle his clients till then.
Michael's sportive got cancelled because of the weather warning. He's gutted.
Rosa got the acting manager role! Starts the Monday after Mia goes. Her husband Sam is taking her out for dinner that weekend. Must send her flowers.
Need to finish the Popescu proposal by Friday. Then book flights for Christmas.

Efua had the baby! A girl, Ama, 7lb 2oz, on 28 February 2027. Joe says the birth was long but they're both fine. He's off till April. Don't forget a card and a little gift, she likes those Scandi wooden toys.

Kerry's due date for her second is 22 August 2027. She's worried because the first was an emergency c-section. She has a consultant appointment the week before half term. Check in with her afterwards.
Louis and Rebecca are getting baby Arlo christened on 4 April 2027. Lunch at the pub after. They want me to do a reading. I'll practise that week.
Fatima says the new manager, Mr Fischer, is very hands-off. She likes it. Her team's finally getting a hiring budget.
Zara and Oisín bought a house in Bristol! Moving in on 15 January 2027, two weeks before the baby is due. Zara's a bit panicked about timing. Oisín's brother Rory is helping with the van.

Talked to Cem after work. He's applying for the senior role on Haruto's team, interview on the 12th, panel of three including Haruto's boss. His partner Idris thinks he's a shoo-in. Cem is nervous though, last time he blanked on the case study. Text him good luck the morning of and ask how it went that evening.
Talked to Cem after work. He's applying for the senior role on Haruto's team, interview on the 12th. His partner Idris thinks he's a shoo-in. Cem is nervous though. Text him good luck the morning of.

Grace was asking about Theo's christening date, they're thinking May 2027. Her husband Lee's family are coming from Seoul so they need a long weekend. She asked if I'd be godmother. Find out which weekend works for her mum.
Spoke to Simone. The twins are crawling now. She's back at work in two weeks and dreading leaving them. Her mum is doing childcare Mondays and Tuesdays.
Oscar's boss Deepa had her baby boy on 2 November 2026. Deepa sent the team a photo of him asleep on Mango the cat. Oscar's organising a collection, put a tenner in.
Reza's anniversary with Noor is the 12th. He wants to book somewhere nice but they've got a newborn. Recommended the Italian with the private room. He hates crowds.
Kasia's maternity leave starts 1 March 2027. She's nervous about the handover, especially the Gonzalez account. Offered to shadow her that week. Remind me to book time with her the week before.

Kasia's maternity leave starts 1 March 2027. She's nervous about the handover, especially the Gonzalez account, because the client contact there is new and a bit prickly. Her manager Louis wants a written plan by the end of January. Offered to shadow her calls the last fortnight. Remind me to book time with her the week before.

Haruto's mum, Mrs Le, is visiting from Osaka for the baby's first month celebration, staying six weeks. Haruto said she's cooking for everyone and has already reorganised their kitchen. The party's the weekend of 14 December 2026, I'm invited. His wife Kasia is apparently finding it a lot. Get a gift for the baby, maybe a little silver spoon.
